answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch-specific polynomial; Semaphore membership proofs establish eligibility, while RLN proofs bind each message to a nullifier and polynomial evaluation. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch yields two distinct Shamir shares, allowing observers to recover the private key and verify the committed identity. The contract can then slash the bond immediately. A comet beacon may identify the epoch, while relic is merely a label, not a security assumption.
